scope_ko: 이상적인 회로·소자·FIFO·캐시·전송선·측정 불확도 계산 모델 검증
scope_en: Verification of ideal circuit, device, FIFO, cache, transmission-line and measurement-uncertainty models

independent_checks.rc: Analytical endpoints versus Euler integration and step refinement
independent_checks.rlc: Closed-form roots versus RK4 in underdamped, critical and overdamped regimes; energy limits
independent_checks.mos: Closed form versus numerical channel-charge integral
independent_checks.fifo: Ring-array implementation versus deque, 98304 exhaustive and 20000 randomized cycles
independent_checks.cache: Address/tag model versus independent block-residency model; trace-summed average latency
independent_checks.line: Power conservation, matched/open/short boundaries, arrival timing and DC-divider convergence
independent_checks.measurement: DC divider, single-pole cutoff, covariance limits and 30000 Monte Carlo samples

rtl_execution.reason_ko: 검증 환경의 PATH에 Icarus Verilog와 Verilator가 없음
rtl_execution.reason_en: Neither Icarus Verilog nor Verilator is available on the validation environment PATH
